sourceRefs.locator: No. 12, opening: second year of Childeric, Pippin as dux et princeps, city of Soissons, bishops, clergy, counts and magnates.
Section Childerich III, pp. 209–211, especially points b–f: the Soissons capitulary, the Wissembourg charter, the ninth regnal year on the Attigny original and the change of dynasty.
No. 2921, Paris AN K 4 no. 7: original parchment; opening line names Pippin and Attigny, the following pleading names Fulrad, Ragana and her representative, the conclusion dates by Childeric.

summary.de: Das Kapitular von Soissons zählt nach seinem zweiten, das Urteil aus Attigny nach seinem neunten Königsjahr.
summary.en: The Soissons capitulary counts from his second year as king, and the Attigny judgment from his ninth.
